test_ml1_benchmark: test all ML1 benchmark environments by verifying train and test task uniqueness and environment stability
test_ml10_benchmark: test the ML10 benchmark suite by validating train and test environment task randomization and positions
test_ml45_benchmark: test the ML45 benchmark suite by checking train and test environment observations and target positions

test_mt50_benchmark: test the MT50 multitask benchmark by validating 50 unique environments and their target positions
